import hashlib, runpy, sys
p = sys.argv[1]
expected = sys.argv[2]
if hashlib.sha256(open(p, "rb").read()).hexdigest() != expected:
    raise ValueError("driver source digest differs")
sys.argv = [p] + sys.argv[3:]
runpy.run_path(p, run_name="__main__")
